content: So I’ve had the Steam Machine for 2 weeks now, and this is just a small update. I’ve been using it almost everyday a little bit to play some games that were just idling on my Steam library, even some GoG ones. Super snappy UI, boots fast even from cold boot, the controller is comfortable. The Steam UI even works with the TV remote which is a nice touch, it’s pretty cool to just use the TV to play PC games instead of staying more works at the desk after work which was my main goal.
